reason: Both correctly identify the gurgle, click and crack as normal refrigerant, thermostat/valve and expansion noises, with no unsupported fault claims or parts. Conversation 1 edges it by actually confirming the key unknowns through dialogue (level, nothing touching, 4C/-18C, single click then steady hum) and then giving a firm 'no fault pattern' verdict with escalation tightly bounded to loud buzzing/rattling, lost cooling or repeated click-hum cycling. Conversation 2 is thorough and model-aware (NoFrost dampers, defrost cycle, recording the noise) but front-loads everything without verifying anything, and its 'book an engineer visit if you're still worried' slightly over-invites escalation that the ground truth says is not needed.
